answer: Each new agent identity must solve a memory-hard proof-of-useful-work puzzle costing 20 GPU-seconds, and the required compute budget grows quadratically: the n-th identity needs 20n² GPU-seconds. Attestation quorums of 5 peers emit a pulse check every epoch; if a peer's delta between claimed and observed compute exceeds 10%, the identity's work-proof is voided and it is pruned from the agent garden registry, forcing full re-solve.
